description: This file defines an interface 'IStorageManager' in the WPEFramework's Exchange namespace. The interface includes virtual methods for managing storage related to applications, such as creating, retrieving, deleting, and clearing storage for apps. It also contains comments, licensing info, and includes external dependencies.

classes.name: IStorageManager
classes.description: An interface for storage management, providing methods for creating, retrieving, deleting, and clearing app storage.

methods.name: CreateStorage
methods.description: Creates storage for a specified application ID with a given size, returning a path or an error reason.

methods.name: GetStorage
methods.description: Retrieves the storage location, size, and used space for a specified application ID and user/group IDs.

methods.name: DeleteStorage
methods.description: Deletes storage associated with a specified application ID.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears storage data for a specified application ID, including device storage.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Clears all application storage data except for exempted app IDs.
